Given the matrix $A$ above, evaluate the quadratic form $Q(\mathbf{x}) = \mathbf{x}^T \! A \mathbf{x}$ when ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14167787/assets/815a776cae60244113513dc20183d05caeece6aaef807fd65e5c4ac819f2d4d3.svg)
question.worked_solution:
Substituting ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14167787/assets/e8a68c7428583d7df9f7fb18faf50f315192475e2f9bb12d051ccc1fda5638a3.svg) into the expression for $Q(\mathbf{x}),$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}Q(x) & ={x}^{T}\,Ax \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-2 & 1 \\ 1 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 23\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =86.\end{aligned}
$$
